component.name: Drivebridge
component.summary: Two-way Google Drive sync that won't lose your files

description.p: Drivebridge keeps a folder on your computer and a folder on Google Drive in sync, in both directions, and is built around not losing data.

ul.li: Every sync is planned and checked first; a sync that would delete many files stops and asks
Files changed on both sides keep both copies
Files a sync removes from your computer stay in a trash for 30 days
An unreachable Drive is treated as offline, never as "everything was deleted"
Google Docs, Sheets and Slides appear as links that open in your browser
Signs in with your own Google Cloud OAuth client; the token stays in your keyring
